standard_prerequisites.name: The single-complex base change lemma and its condition-inheritance corollary reduce base change assertions for maps into internal-Hom pushforwards to the verification of the equivalent conditions for a canonical comparison map
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the assertion to the underived pullback comparison map.

standard_prerequisites.name: The canonical map from the derived pullback to the underived pullback of the flat complex G satisfies the base change conditions, as shown in the proof of the tensor base change lemma using the flatness of the terms

core_obligations: Spell out the assertion: for the cartesian square with g : S' -> S, the natural map Lg^* Rf_* R SheafHom(E, G^bullet) -> R(f')_* R SheafHom(L(g')^* E, (g')^* G^bullet) — with the underived pullback on G^bullet — must be an isomorphism (proof lines 6947-6961).

Apply the single-complex base change lemma and the condition-inheritance lemma: it suffices to show the canonical map L(g')^* G^bullet -> (g')^* G^bullet satisfies the equivalent conditions of the single-complex base change condition lemma (proof lines 6966-6970).

This verification was already carried out in the proof of the tensor base change lemma, where the flatness of the terms G^n over S gives the required compatibility; conclude the isomorphism (proof lines 6971-6972).
proof_roadmap: Spell out the base change map with the underived pullback on G (proof lines 6947-6961).
Reduce via the single-complex machinery to the underived pullback comparison (proof lines 6962-5268).
Conclude by the verification from the tensor base change proof (proof lines 6971-6972).
